steps.title: Understand what this service sends
steps.body: Ua Companion Orb Overlay streams MuseTalk grayscale face masks to the Unreal Companion Orb overlay. It is a stream service, not a settings form, so there are no option tabs here. Read the Addon Manager entry to see how it is listed. Real operation requires MuseTalk and the Unreal overlay to be running.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Where to enable and explain it
steps.body: Because this entry has no settings, enablement and explanation belong in the Addon Manager. Look there for the listed service and its description. A running stream depends on MuseTalk providing face-mask frames and the Unreal overlay consuming them; without both, the service has nothing to carry. No settings appear on this page.
